protocol.split_unit: entire source paper and all its derived variants/paragraphs
protocol.fit_records: Human full-body segments and isolated generated-paragraph segments; mixed documents are evaluation only.
protocol.feature_family: Regularized linear fusion of standardized logits of four raw model scores only.
protocol.selection: Paper-grouped leave-one-paper-out on fit only; maximize generated-character recall under zero human flags using training-only thresholds. Tie: more regularization, more human weight.
protocol.threshold_selection: Maximum human score from fit+calibration plus predeclared logit margins 0.5 (review) and 1.0 (strong); calibration AI scores are diagnostic only.
protocol.objective: Zero observed human flags on fit/calibration; maximize recall subject to that constraint.
protocol.test_policy: Freeze profile before reading held-out test metrics; never adjust it using test results.
protocol.uncertainty: Ten papers in one subject; zero observed flags does not prove a zero population false-positive rate.
